pullRequests.title: Match scalar min/max in C with pinned PS2DEV GCC 3.2.3
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/rac1-gcc323-float-20261027
pullRequests.body:
Reconstructs func_001F9B90 (max_float) and func_001F9B98 (min_float) as ordinary C comparisons, exactly 8 bytes each. GCC 2.95 adds a register copy; the published PS2DEV GCC 3.2.3 frontend emits the required scalar operations and preserves the existing FastAbsF and IntToFloat bodies.
The entire fastfunc.c object uses an explicit compiler profile with file-wide -ffast-math. Setup pins and verifies the GNU release and published PS2DEV patch. The original assembler/linker pipeline remains…

pullRequests.title: core: sceCdInit (func_001211B0) without the register pin
pullRequests.author: xx255q
pullRequests.head: clean/sce-cd-init-no-pin
pullRequests.body:
Removes the register pin (register int m __asm__("$4")) from sce_cd_init (func_001211B0, sceCdInit) in src/core/001208E8.c.
Retail keeps the shared -1 in $a0; without the pin, local-alloc put it in $v1. Passing cd_scmd_sync's non-blocking argument through a local (int no_wait = 1;) changes the allocation order so the -1 lands in $a0 again, with no pin, inline asm or barrier.

Same object code as the pinned version (function bytes and relocations compared).
The permuter result it was reduced…
